items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Well, during that time they had a fella I know by the name of Wooden Joe.

ctx.x: You might go into detail a little bit more about some of those bands. Like when you played with John Kazimer, who else was in the band?
Well, during that time they had a fella I know by the name of Wooden Joe. Oh yeah, sure.
